name: seq-mcp
description: Query a Seq structured-log server: Seq SQL (group by / aggregates), recent errors, event search, and saved signals.
long_description: A token-efficient MCP server for [Seq](https://datalust.co). Exposes Seq SQL querying with aggregates and grouping, recent Error/Fatal events, free-form event search, full single-event detail, and saved-signal listing. Returns terse plain text rather than raw JSON to keep token usage low. Ships as a self-contained Windows executable, so no .NET runtime needs to be installed.

tools.name: seq_query
tools.description: Run a Seq SQL query (supports aggregates / group by), optionally scoped to a signal and time range.

tools.name: recent_errors
tools.description: Most recent Error/Fatal events, newest first.

tools.name: search_events
tools.description: Events matching a Seq filter expression, newest first.

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: Full detail for a single event by id.

tools.name: list_signals
tools.description: Saved signals as Id and Title lines for scoping queries.

seq_server_url.title: Seq server URL
seq_server_url.description: Base URL of your Seq server, e.g. https://seq.example.com or http://localhost:5341.

seq_api_key.title: Seq API key
seq_api_key.description: Seq API key, sent as the X-Seq-ApiKey header. Leave blank if your Seq instance allows anonymous read.
